source: FA3 goes further on Hopper by overlapping matrix multiplication, softmax, and data movement using asynchronous hardware features. FA4 responds to Blackwell, where tensor-core throughput increased faster than some other resources, making exponentials and shared-memory traffic relatively more important.[6, 7]
zh: FA3 在 Hopper 的基础上更进一步，通过使用异步硬件功能来重叠矩阵乘法、softmax 和数据移动。 FA4 响应 Blackwell，其中张量核心吞吐量比其他一些资源增长得更快，使得指数和共享内存流量相对更加重要。 [6, 7]
